CloudBackupVault.title: CloudBackupVault
CloudBackupVault.description: Serialized full finance database backup snapshot stored per authenticated Google user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the backup owner.

email.description: Connected Gmail address of the backup owner.

exportedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the snapshot was exported.

accountCount.description: Number of financial accounts in the backup.

transactionCount.description: Number of ledger transactions in the backup.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the backup record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the backup record was last updated.

DualWalletSummary.title: DualWalletSummary
DualWalletSummary.description: Cloud mirror of a user's FinPlay Pro Tournament Wallet, Game Wallet, and equipped Armory items.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the wallet owner.

winningBalance.description: Withdrawable Winning Coins balance earned from tournament victories.

gameBalance.description: Game Wallet coin balance (one-way transfer & 100% tournament loss cashback).

equippedBoardSkinId.description: Currently equipped Armory board skin ID.

ownedItemsCsv.description: Comma-separated list of owned Armory skin/avatar IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when wallet summary was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when wallet summary was last updated.

WalletRequestDoc.title: WalletRequestDoc
WalletRequestDoc.description: Manual bKash, Nagad, or Rocket deposit/withdrawal request awaiting Admin review.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting user.

channel.description: Payment channel (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or Binance Pay/TRC20).

accountNumber.description: Sender/receiver mobile number, Binance Pay ID, or USDT TRC20 address.

transactionId.description: Mobile banking TrxID for deposit verification.

adminNote.description: Optional note left by Admin upon approval/rejection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when request was last updated.

MultiplayerRoomDoc.title: MultiplayerRoomDoc
MultiplayerRoomDoc.description: Real-time online multiplayer game room supporting 6-digit Room Code invites and Public Quick Match.

roomCode.description: 6-character uppercase alphanumeric room code (matches document ID).

gameType.description: Game type hosted in this room.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the host player (Player 1).

hostName.description: Display name and avatar crest of the host.

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joining guest player (Player 2), empty while waiting.

guestName.description: Display name and avatar crest of the guest player.

memberUids.description: Array of participant UIDs ([hostUid] while waiting, [hostUid, guestUid] while playing).

publicRoom.description: True if discoverable via Quick Match; false for private Room Code invites.

entryFee.description: Optional Tournament entry tier for this match (0 for free).

turnUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player whose turn is active.

winnerUid.description: Winning player UID, 'DRAW', or empty string while ongoing.

statePayload.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of the board game state.

lastMoveSummary.description: Human-readable summary of the last move.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when room was last updated.

WalletLedgerDoc.title: WalletLedgerDoc
WalletLedgerDoc.description: Real-time Firestore-synced Tournament, Winning, and Game Wallet transaction history entry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the wallet owner.

walletBucket.description: Wallet bucket affected by this ledger transaction.

kind.description: Ledger event kind (e.g. DEPOSIT_APPROVED, TOURNAMENT_ENTRY, TOURNAMENT_WIN_PRIZE).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the ledger entry was recorded.

BroadcastDoc.title: BroadcastDoc
BroadcastDoc.description: Real-time Admin broadcast announcement and Free Fire room alert delivered to all signed-in users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the broadcast was published.

TournamentDoc.title: Tournament
TournamentDoc.description: Canonical Firestore 'tournaments' collection data model storing title, entry fee, prize pool, player UIDs, scheduled start timestamp, game type (e.g. Ludo, Free Fire), and Arena Hub metadata.

gameType.description: Primary game type hosted by this tournament (e.g. LUDO, FREE_FIRE).

prizePool.description: Total prize pool in Winning Coins.

playerUids.description: Ordered list of registered player Firebase Auth UIDs.

startTime.description: Native Firestore Timestamp when the tournament is scheduled to start.

gameCategory.description: Mirrored game category label for Hub filtering compatibility.

modeLabel.description: Match mode label (e.g., SQUAD, SOLO, 5P LUDO, BLITZ).

prizeRanksJson.description: JSON encoded list of multi-rank prizes.

joinedCount.description: Current number of joined participants (synced with playerUids.size).

startTimeLabel.description: Formatted display label of scheduled match start.

matchStartTimeMillis.description: UTC epoch milliseconds synchronized with startTime Timestamp.

preMatchAlertMinutes.description: Minutes before start when pre-match room alert activates.

roomAlertSent.description: True after Admin dispatches the Room ID & Password alert.

roomIdCode.description: Custom room ID or match lobby code.

localRoomId.description: Optional Room database ID bridge for local mirror deduplication.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when tournament was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when tournament was last updated.

TournamentEntryDoc.title: TournamentEntryDoc
TournamentEntryDoc.description: Deterministic per-user participant registration inside a Firestore tournament's live roster.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the registered player.

TournamentLeaderboardEntry.title: TournamentLeaderboardEntry
TournamentLeaderboardEntry.description: Real-time ranked tournament player stats queried by matchPoints descending (Top 10 leaderboard).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the ranked player (matches document ID).

displayName.description: Public player display name shown on the Tournament Leaderboard.

matchPoints.description: Cumulative competitive match points used for Top 10 ranking.

totalCoinsEarned.description: Total coins earned across competitive matches.

favoriteGame.description: Most recently played or signature game type (e.g., WAR_LAND, LUDO, FREE_FIRE).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when leaderboard profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest points update.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: Per-user private cloud backup vault documents (e.g. 'latest').

/users/{userId}/wallet/{walletDocId}.description: Per-user Dual Wallet & Armory cloud summary.

/users/{userId}/wallet_ledger/{entryId}.description: Per-user real-time Tournament/Winning/Game Wallet transaction history.

/wallet_requests/{requestId}.description: Manual bKash/Nagad/Rocket/Binance deposit & withdrawal requests reviewed by Admin.

/multiplayer_rooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time online multiplayer rooms supporting 6-digit Room Code invites and Quick Match.

/broadcasts/{broadcastId}.description: Real-time Admin broadcast alerts synced to all signed-in FinPlay Pro clients.

/tournaments/{tournamentId}.description: Centralized live Tournament Hub documents synced in real time across all players.

/tournaments/{tournamentId}/entries/{ent.description: Real-time per-tournament joined players roster (deterministic entryId == userId).

/tournament_leaderboard/{userId}.description: Real-time Top 10 Tournament Leaderboard ranked by matchPoints descending.
